english.title: Fail to report loss of relevant explosive to police
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),

(A)_[having acquired possession of a relevant explosive,]_
(B)_[having kept a relevant explosive,]_
(C)_[having loaded a relevant explosive,]_
(D)_[having unloaded a relevant explosive,]_
(E)_[having transported a relevant explosive,]_
(F)_[being the occupier of a place where a relevant explosive was loaded while on a journey,]_
(G)_[being the occupier of a place where a relevant explosive was unloaded while on a journey,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY EXPLOSIVE..), failed to ensure that its loss was reported forthwith to

(H)_[the chief officer of police for the police area in which the loss occurred]_
(I)_[the chief officer of police for the police area in which the loss occurred and the Executive]_
(J)_[the chief officer of police for the police area in which the loss occurred and the ONR]_
(K)_[the chief officer of police for the police area in which the loss was discovered, it not being known where the loss occurred]_
(L)_[the chief officer of police for the police area in which the loss was discovered, it not being known where the loss occurred and the Executive]_
(M)_[the chief officer of police for the police area in which the loss was discovered, it not being known where the loss occurred and the ONR]_
(N)_[a chief officer of police, the loss having occurred or been discovered outside Great Britain]_
(O)_[a chief officer of police, the loss having occurred or been discovered outside Great Britain and the Executive]_
(P)_[a chief officer of police, the loss having occurred or been discovered outside Great Britain and the ONR]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 37(1) of the Explosives Regulations 2014 and section 33(1)(c) and (2) of the Health and Safety at Work Act 1974.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
having acquired possession of or kept or loaded or unloaded or transported a relevant explosive or
been the occupier of a place where a relevant explosive was loaded or unloaded while on a journey,
failed to ensure that its loss was reported forthwith to the chief officer of police for the police area in which the loss occurred or
the chief officer of police for the police area in which the loss was discovered, if not known where the loss occurred or
a chief officer of police if the loss occurred or was discovered outside Great Britain
and the Executive or ONR where appropriate

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
Regulation 37 of the Explosives Regulations 2014 states:
37(7) Where any loss of a relevant explosive occurs at a site in relation to which the Executive is the licensing authority by virtue of Schedule 1, then any requirement in this regulation to report or supply information to a chief officer of police also includes a like requirement to report or supply the same information to the Executive.
37(8) Where any loss of a relevant explosive occurs at a site in relation to which the ONR is the licensing authority by virtue of paragraph 4 of Schedule 1, then any requirement in this regulation to report or supply information to a chief officer of police also includes a like requirement to report or supply the same information to the ONR.
